doc.title: Buster Williams interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 6, 2002

title: Closing remarks and invitation to the Vanguard
summary: Thanks and goodbyes, chat about Clinton, New York, and an invitation to his Vanguard opening.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well this has been fascinating for me.
Me too.
Is there anything that I should have asked you that I didn’t?
Uh um. No. I enjoyed this interview because you didn’t ask me standard kind of things, you asked me things that gave me a chance to just talk.
Good.
And you can always go to the Internet and find out anything you want.
More than you ever need to know.
That’s right. No this was fun.
Well I wish you the best with your quartet and I hope to catch you sometime.
Are you going to be in town next week?
I’m not scheduled.
When are you going back?
We’re going back Tuesday.
Well you’re only going to Clinton, New Jersey, right?
Clinton, New York.
Clinton, New York. Not even New Jersey.
It’s only five hours.
Oh you drove?
Yeah.
It’s a drive, huh? So what’s up there? You are up near Albany?
We are past Albany in Utica. We’re outside Utica.
So you’re going back when?
Tuesday morning.
Well I open Tuesday night. That’s the day after tomorrow.
I could extend our stay.
Well if you can, you’re invited.
All right.
At the Vanguard.
Great. Well thank you for your time.
Thank you.
